entities.name: Emina
entities.description: Rich noble on Shandalar whose family was made wealthy by Relno's inventions.

entities.name: Relno
entities.description: Wizard and inventor who made Emina's family wealthy and powerful.

events.summary: Relno visited Emina; she gave him a withering look to dissuade him from asking for more money.
events.quote: she gave him the most withering look she could muster

events.summary: Relno asked for five thousand, and Emina granted it and bid him leave.
events.quote: when he asked for five thousand, she granted it and bid him leave immediately

relations.note: He made her family wealthy with his inventions and asks her for money.
relations.quote: He was the one who made her family wealthy and powerful with his inventions
